mechanism: Chlorpromazine may increase primaquine levels through CYP450 inhibition (CYP2D6, CYP3A4) and both drugs have additive CNS depressant effects and potential for hemolytic toxicity in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for increased primaquine toxicity, hemolytic anemia risk, and CNS depression; consider alternative antipsychotic or antimalarial if possible; assess G6PD status before primaquine use.
